newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - District of Columbia.

text.p: NOTICE OF SALE
District of Columbia
(Washington, D.C.)
General Obligation Bond Act of 1997
Sealed bids will be received by the Chief Financial
Officer until 11:00 A.M. Eastern Daylight Savings Time on
September 26, 1996
at his office at 441 Fourth Street, N.W., Suite 1150,
Washington, D.C., 20001 (Attention: Anthony A. Williams,
Chief Financial Officer) for the purchase of $170,000,000*
aggregate principal amount of District of Columbia (the
District'') 1997 General Obligation Bonds (Series 1997A)
(the Bonds'') dated September 15, 1996. No proposal shall
be considered unless there is deposited with the District as
a down-payment a certified check or cashier's check for an
amount equal to at least two per centum of the par amount of
general obligation bonds bid for. The District reserves the
right to cancel the sale or reject any and all bids.
The Bonds are issued for the purpose of financing certain
capital projects and or refunding certain capital
indebtedness of the District of Columbia. The Bonds are
general obligations of the District of Columbia and the full
faith and credit of the District of Columbia is pledged to
the payment of the principal and interest on the Bonds when
due. The Bonds are further secured by a perfected security
interest in and lien on the funds derived from a special
real property tax levied by the District and required to be
collected annually, without limitation as to rate or amount,
in amounts sufficient to pay the principal and interest on
the Bonds and any outstanding Parity Bonds when due. The
funds derived from the special real property tax are
subject to the security interest and lien when collected by
the District. When collected, such funds shall be set aside
in a separate fund dedicated to the payment of principal of
and interest on the Bonds and any outstanding Parity Bonds.
Copies of the Official Terms of the Bond Sale, the
Official Bid Form, the Preliminary Official Statement, and
the Form of Opinion of Squire, Sanders & Dempsey, Bond
Counsel may be obtained from Lasana Mack, Debt Manager, 441
Fourth Street N.W., Suite 360, Washington, DC 20001, (202)
*Preliminary subject to change
Anthony Williams
Chief Financial Officer
District of Columbia
Dated:September 16, 1996
(From The Bond Buyer)
--U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
